newsitem.title: USA: CUNO sees higher Q4, year oper income.
newsitem.headline: CUNO sees higher Q4, year oper income.

text.p: CUNO Inc said Thursday it expects higher operating income, excluding nonrecurring costs, for the fiscal fourth quarter and year ended October 31, but net income for the year will be lower due to costs.
It said expects operating income for the year to be significantly higher than the previous year.

The company said operating income and net income for the year, excluding costs, are expected to exceed earlier projections made in connection with the recent spinoff of CUNO from Commercial Intertech Corp.

However, net income for the year will be down from 1995 due to costs of about $5 million relating to reorganization of the business and the company's move toward standing alone after the spinoff, it said.
For the fourth quarter, operating income is likely to be higher than a year ago, with almost all operating units expected to report higher earnings versus the fourth quarter of 1995, it said.
CUNO said a refinancing program was completed in the fourth quarter to provide it with "adequate credit facilities" for future business needs.
It said it will release financial results for fiscal 1996 and the fourth quarter later this month.
